eps_policy.basic_eps_fallback: Only when explicitly labeled or when Diluted unavailable
eps_policy.verification_price: Use T-1 ADJ Close (day before report date) for cross-check against broker_report values

valuation_dual_track.rule: All valuation values are computed on TWO tracks for every report

track_A_verification.name: Report Date Verification Track
track_A_verification.purpose: Verify broker_report stated valuation values match T-1 ADJ Close calculation
track_A_verification.eps_input: Diluted EPS for the valuation base year stated in report
track_A_verification.action_on_fail: Flag for human review; record discrepancy in audit log; preserve broker value

track_B_realtime.name: Latest Realtime Valuation Track
track_B_realtime.purpose: Compute current-state valuation using LATEST available ADJ Close
track_B_realtime.price_input: adj_close (latest T-day, queried at S05 run time)
track_B_realtime.eps_input: Diluted EPS for the same base year as Track A
track_B_realtime.tolerance: N/A — realtime is informational, not validated
track_B_realtime.action_on_drift: If realtime upside_pct differs from report by >5pp, mark report 'STALE'
